phaseFocus.1: Pain/inflammation control, quad activation, basic ROM

1.name: Quad Sets
1.cue: Squeeze quad muscle, press knee down into mat. Hold 2 seconds.

1.name: Heel Props
1.cue: Heel on towel roll, ankle weight on knee. Relax and let knee straighten.

1.name: Heel Slides
1.cue: Slide heel toward buttock, return slowly. Use strap if needed.

1.name: Straight Leg Raises
1.cue: Tighten quad, lift leg to height of opposite knee. Lower slowly.

1.name: Glute Bridges
1.cue: Squeeze glutes, lift hips. Keep core engaged.

1.name: Clamshells
1.cue: Band above knees. Keep feet together, open knees like a clam.

1.name: Hamstring Curls
1.cue: Lie face down, band around ankle. Curl heel toward buttock.

2.name: Quad Sets
2.cue: Squeeze quad, press knee down. Hold 2 seconds per rep.

2.name: Heel Slides
2.cue: Slide heel toward buttock, hold 3 sec, return slowly.

2.name: Straight Leg Raises
2.cue: Lift with quad only—no swinging. Control the descent.

2.name: Short Arc Quads
2.cue: Foam roll under knee, straighten leg. Hold at top.

2.name: Glute Bridges
2.cue: Drive through heels, squeeze glutes at top.

2.name: Clamshells
2.cue: Rotate hip open, keep core braced. No rolling back.

2.name: Single Leg Bridges
2.cue: Extend one leg, lift on injured side. More challenging.

2.name: Terminal Knee Extensions
2.cue: Band behind knee, pull forward to straighten.

3.name: Single Leg Bridges
3.cue: Extend one leg, lift on injured side. 3 sec hold at top.

3.name: Clamshells
3.cue: Higher reps for endurance. Keep hips level.

3.name: Standing Hip Abduction
3.cue: Band around ankles, lift leg out to side. Control return.

3.name: Mini Squats
3.cue: Hold counter for balance. Only go as low as comfortable.

3.name: Step Ups
3.cue: Step up with injured leg. Control the descent.

3.name: Single Leg Stance
3.cue: Stand on injured leg. Progress to eyes closed.

3.name: Hamstring Slider
3.cue: Lie on back, slide heel in and out. Squeeze glutes.

3.name: Standing Calf Raises
3.cue: Rise onto toes, lower slowly. Hold wall for balance.

4.name: Single Leg RDL
4.cue: Hinge at hip, extend free leg back. Use wall for balance.

4.name: Split Squats
4.cue: Step back into lunge, lower until back knee taps floor.

4.name: Lateral Step Downs
4.cue: Stand on step, lower heel to floor. Don't collapse knee.

4.name: Band Walks
4.cue: Squat slightly, walk sideways into band. Keep tension.

4.name: Single Leg Bridge
4.cue: Hold 3 sec at top. Progress by adding weight.

4.name: Single Leg Calf Raises
4.cue: Rise on injured leg only. Full range of motion.

4.name: Single Leg Stance
4.cue: Stand on cushion or pillow. Add head turns.

4.name: Cossack Squats
4.cue: Wide stance, shift weight side to side. Hold counter.

5.name: Single Leg Squat
5.cue: Lower to box/chair. Control descent. No bouncing.

5.name: Single Leg RDL
5.cue: Hinge with weight in opposite hand. Back straight.

5.name: Double Leg Jumps
5.cue: Jump off floor, land soft. Both feet together.

5.name: Lateral Hops
5.cue: Hop side to side over line. Land controlled.

5.name: Pogo Jumps
5.cue: Quick hops, stay on balls of feet. Minimal ground time.

5.name: Single Leg Hops
5.cue: Hop forward. Focus on landing quality, not distance.

5.name: Box Jumps
5.cue: Jump onto box. Step down. Control the landing.

1.name: Stationary Bike
1.cue: Low resistance, focus on full pedal circle. Warm up.

1.name: Leg Press
1.cue: Only go to 45° knee bend. Focus on quad control.

1.name: Seated Hamstring Curls
1.cue: Control the eccentric. No jerky movements.

1.name: Cable Terminal Knee Ext
1.cue: 90° to 45° range. Squeeze quad at full extension.

1.name: Exercise Ball Curls
1.cue: Bridge up, roll ball with heels. Control the return.

1.name: Leg Extensions
1.cue: 90° to full extension. No pad pressure on shin.

2.name: Leg Press
2.cue: Deeper range now. Both legs, then single leg variations.

2.name: Seated Hamstring Curls
2.cue: Both legs, then single. Full range.

2.name: Goblet Squats
2.cue: Hold weight at chest. Keep chest up, knees out.

2.name: Step Ups
2.cue: Use low step. Drive through heel, not toes.

2.name: Prone Terminal Knee Ext
2.cue: Cable behind knee, lie prone. Extend fully.

2.name: Seated Calf Raises
2.cue: Full stretch at bottom, rise fully on toes.

3.name: Single Leg Press
3.cue: Focus on the injured leg. Full range.

3.name: Goblet Squats
3.cue: Deeper squat, heavier weight. Chest up.

3.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
3.cue: Back foot elevated on bench. Hold rack for balance.

3.name: Romanian Deadlifts
3.cue: Hinge at hips, keep bar close. Feel hamstrings.

3.name: Leg Extensions
3.cue: Slow and controlled. Full squeeze at top.

3.name: Hip Sled
3.cue: Focus on quad control through full range.

4.name: Back Squats
4.cue: Focus on form. Box squats for control.

4.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
4.cue: No hands. Full depth if possible.

4.name: Single Leg RDL
4.cue: Dumbbell in opposite hand. Hip hinge.

4.name: Nordic Curl Negatives
4.cue: Slow eccentric only. Catch with hands.

5.name: Back Squats
5.cue: Working sets. Focus on depth and form.

5.name: Deadlifts
5.cue: Conventional or sumo. Keep back neutral.
